name: Calu Jackfruit-Anise Drift
description: A mellow, slightly creamy soda built on synth-jackfruit base with a clean star anise finish. Calu markets it as a 'slow sip' drink — something you nurse rather than chug.
flavor_profile: Sweet tropical fruit up front, faintly floral, with a dry licorice-adjacent finish and mild effervescence
cultural_context: Beloved by overnight shift workers in Tier 2 manufacturing blocks who want something sweet but not aggressive. Calu's unhurried branding is quietly aspirational — it implies you have time to relax, which most people don't.
story_hooks: A Calu distribution route has gone missing — three drivers, two trucks, no signal. The manifest shows nothing unusual, but someone inside Calu's logistics arm clearly disagrees.
A Tier 2 community center uses Calu Drift sales to fund a hidden medical clinic. Someone upstairs just noticed the revenue discrepancy.
The anise compound in recent batches has been subtly altered — not harmful, but detectably different. A flavor chemist is trying to figure out if it's sabotage or a supply chain substitution.
